title: Games AI Plays
description: See how games became the proving ground for AI. From checkers to chess to Go to StarCraft, each challenge pushed researchers to invent new techniques that later transformed AI.
targetAudience: Gamers and those interested in AI breakthroughs through games
keyTakeaways: Arthur Samuel coined 'machine learning' with his checkers program
Deep Blue's chess victory showed brute-force search limits
AlphaGo used deep RL to develop intuition for Go
AlphaZero learned superhuman play from self-play alone
